s2_gerda_route_035_basement_maria.text: Maria?

Rumor has it he knows exactly who is sleeping with whom and who owes what in this town better than the actual police. The only question is to whom and when he will decide to sell that information.
University student, 21 years old. Darnell's sister. Tall, athletic African-American woman. Track rival to Tiffany. Strict, ambitious, and highly competitive.

21 years old. A walking fever dream. You're never quite sure if you saw her in reality or if she just slipped out of a hallucination. A silent figure, a blank mask, and an empty gaze. But there is something in the tilt of her head, some tiny, impossible detail that sends a cold shiver down your spine. You sincerely hope you never wake up enough to realize exactly who she reminds you of.

University Professor, 41 years old. Tall, elegant, with impeccable posture. Wears strict pencil skirts and blouses that tightly constrain a large bust. Hair in a flawless bun. Demeanor is cold, strict, and flawlessly authoritative.

46 years old. Harry's wife. Tall, aristocratic, elegant. Green eyes, light chestnut hair. Wears expensive designer suits. Cold, snobbish, and arrogantly dismissive of anyone with lower social status (including the MC). Highly functioning alcoholic with a preference for fine wines.

University student, 21 years old. Track and field athlete. Physique is highly toned and lean: flat stomach, athletic legs, and tight, muscular buttocks. Modest, perky breasts. Pale skin heavily dusted with ginger freckles (prominent on thighs and rear). Friendly and energetic, but currently exhibiting high stress and poor academic performance. Associated with Darnell.

Waitress at the local diner, 35+ years old. A tall, good-natured, and phenomenally naive woman. Her cheap uniform is practically bursting at the seams, struggling to contain gigantic proportions that clearly show the heavy marks of motherhood. Violet is the type who sincerely believes in horoscopes and genuinely can't understand why half the male customers constantly "accidentally" drop their forks under the table whenever she comes over to take an order.

University Dean, 55 years old. Tall, graying, impeccably dressed in tailored suits. Pragmatic, calculating, and emotionally distant. A ruthless administrator who protects the university's image at all costs. Extremely observant, prioritizing institutional reputation over individual well-being.

University student, 20 years old. Peter's only friend. Short, Indian descent, with a doughy, overweight physique. Acne-prone, wears thick glasses, and suffers from chronic hyperhidrosis (excessive sweating). Socially awkward, cowardly geek with niche pop-culture interests.

44 years old. Mother of Darnell and Chantelle. Tall, vibrant African-American woman. Figure is massive and highly curvaceous, featuring enormous breasts and a very wide, generous rear. Wears bright, revealing dresses. Loud, cheerful, and straightforward. Treats the MC with warm irony and playful affection.

s2_sara_route_010_5_lock.text: (I can't just walk past him. Roger is leaning right against the entrance, completely blocking the way into the smoking shelter.)
(If I try to just push past that meathead, he's going to snap our neck. I need to figure out a way to make him leave first.)

s2_ntr_route_008_1.text: (Shit, shit, shit! Did she look up? Did she see me?)
I held my breath. From downstairs, I heard the back door slide shut, followed by the hurried patter of bare feet on tiles.
Then, the sound of a door locking and water running full blast.
(The bathroom. She's in the downstairs bathroom.)
I waited a moment to compose myself, forcing my breathing to slow, before walking down the stairs.
Just as I reached the bottom step, the bathroom door opened. Steam billowed out, carrying the scent of floral soap and... something else. Something musky.
[M]Mary[-M] stepped out, drying her hair with a towel. She stopped dead when she saw me, her eyes widening in panic.
Oh! [MC]Peter[-MC]! I... I didn't hear you come down.
She looked frantic. Her face was flushed a deep crimson, her chest was heaving under her robe, and beads of sweat were still visible on her neck despite the towel.
Hey. Everything okay? You look... flustered.
(Laughs nervously) Me? No! Just... it's so hot today. I decided to take a quick rinse. To cool off.
(Cool off? You look like you're burning up.)
Anyway! Look at the time. I need to start lunch. The eggs... the salad... I have to go!
She tightened her robe around herself and practically ran past me towards the kitchen, avoiding my gaze entirely.
(She couldn't get away fast enough. She is absolutely panicking.)
(Let her run. She left the best part behind.)
(The bathroom, genius. She just came out of there. Where do you think she put the "evidence"?)
(Go look. Before she comes back to hide it properly.)

s2_sara_route_022.text: Today's lecture felt entirely different right from the start. Professor Arnette was jittery, visibly agitated, and twitchier than I'd ever seen her before.
Without his precious supplements to use as leverage, Darnell sat silently at his desk, shoulders hunched, avoiding eye contact and looking almost… timid?
It was obvious they'd had some kind of confrontation earlier. She occasionally shot venomous glares toward him, her frustration clear as day.
Whenever she asked him questions, she did so with a cold, biting edge, knowing full well he couldn't answer properly.
It was as if she wanted him to fail publicly.
Wrong again, Darnell! Unbelievable!
How many times must I repeat myself for it to get through your thick skull?
Can’t you even pretend to try?
You know what? Fuck this bullshit, I’m out of here. I don’t need this shit anymore.
If you walk out of this lecture, Mr. Darnell, I promise you, you will be immediately reported to the Dean’s office!
Pfft, like I give a damn. Later, losers.
Enraged and embarrassed, Darnell stormed out dramatically, slamming the lecture hall door behind him.
Immediately, the entire lecture hall erupted into a frenzy of whispers, gossip, and excited speculation about what the hell just went down.
Alright, that’s enough chatter! Everyone back to work, now. This isn’t a gossip club; focus on your own studies immediately!
[MC]Peter[-MC], I'm seriously worried. Sara’s acting even stranger than usual today—look at her.
She won’t stop scratching her arm, pacing around, muttering under her breath.
I don't think I've ever seen her this bad.
It'll be okay, Becca, I promise. She's probably just under a ton of stress right now. You know how she gets when the pressure's on.
Maybe you're right, but… this feels different.
She's been on edge for days, snapping at everyone.
And now she's picking fights openly with Darnell? Something is seriously off.
(Heh, no worries, we'll help sweet Sara de-stress real soon—nothing a few intense orgasms won't fix.)
(Can you seriously not think about sex for one damn minute?)
(What else is there to think about when our smoking-hot professor is practically begging for our cock to solve all her problems?)
Let's just… focus on getting through the lecture, okay?
Thanks for always being there, [MC]Peter[-MC]. I really appreciate it… You’re probably the only one here who actually cares about me and Sara.
Of course, Becca. I'm always here if you need anything at all.
(And I'll definitely be here for hot-ass Sara. Very, very closely here…)
(Ugh, you never change, do you?)
(Never have, never will. Now shut up and watch the show—this is getting juicy.)

s2_harry_route_002.text: (I had just arrived at the mansion. It was early morning, the coffee barely kicking in.
(As I stepped into the main hallway, the atmosphere hit me. It was heavy, suffocating, like the air before a thunderstorm.)
...I don't care what the projections say! Fix it! If the stock drops another point by noon, heads will roll!
(He slammed the phone shut and looked around wildly. He spotted Maria, who was dusting a table nearby, and me, just standing there with my gear.)
You. Maid. Gardener. Listen to me.
Yes, sir?
I am locking myself in the study. I have… critical negotiations. A crisis meeting with the board. It will take the entire day.
I am not to be disturbed. Under any circumstances. The house could be burning down, and you do not knock on that door. Is that clear?
Harry, really. You’re shouting. It’s too early for this. We have a dinner reservation at seven tonight.
Cancel it.
Excuse me?
Cancel it, Gerda! Cancel everything! I said I am busy!
I cannot be interrupted by your social calendar or… or anything else! This deals with the future of this family!
Fine. Rot in there for all I care. Just try not to have a stroke, darling. It would be terribly inconvenient to clean up.
Maria. I will need… refreshments. Bring the silver tray. You know the one. In one hour.
Of course, Mr. Sterling. I will prepare everything… exactly as you require.
And you. Stay away from the terrace windows. I don't want to see you lurking around outside while I'm trying to think. Keep to the hedges on the other side of the property.
Yes, sir. Understood.
Good. Now everyone… go.
He retreated into his study and slammed the door. I heard the distinct *click* of a heavy lock turning.
(Did you hear that? 'Stay away from the windows.' 'Critical negotiations.')
(He’s stressed, Red. He’s dealing with a crisis.)
(He’s shaking like a leaf. And he just ordered the maid to bring him 'refreshments' while cancelling dinner with his wife? That doesn't sound like business.)
(That sounds like a man who is about to break. And he specifically told you not to look in the windows.)
(Which means we are definitely going to look in those windows.)

s2_sara_route_013_5.text: Natalie was leaning over the checkout counter. As usual, she was impossible to miss.
Her neon pink bob was bright against the dull fluorescent lights. She was wearing a tight, low-cut dress that clung to her wide hips.
Through the thin fabric of her top, her nipples were visibly erect, pressing against the material.
(Hello, nurse. Looks like the AC is on full blast in here. Or she's just happy to see us.)
She looked up, her dark eyes flashing with amusement behind her stylish glasses.
Well, well. If it isn't my favorite awkward customer.
Cutting a lecture? Or just coming in for a snack?
Hey, Natalie. Neither. I actually need... something specific.
She raised an eyebrow, leaning her elbows on the scratched counter. Her breasts pushed together, giving me quite a view.
"Specific," huh? Sounds intriguing. Go on, entertain me.
I need a coat. A long one. Like... a rain slicker?
A coat? Here? We sell milk and lottery tickets, [MC]Peter[-MC].
Are we going for the "hard-boiled detective" aesthetic, or the "flasher in the produce aisle" vibe? Because honestly, sweetie, it's a thin line.
It's for a... student film. We're shooting a noir scene.
Uh-huh. "Film noir." Sure.
She walked out from behind the counter, her heels clicking on the linoleum. She pulled a dusty beige raincoat from the "Clearance" rack near the detergent.
Try that. It’s been sitting there since April. Cheap, plastic, and covers everything.
(I put it on. It crinkled loudly and smelled like old plastic, but it made me look... nondescript.)
It works. I'll take it. And, uh... do you have any props? Like glasses?
Glasses? I sell reading glasses for old ladies, [MC]Peter[-MC]. Not props.
I need something that changes my face. Like... a disguise. For the "character."
Natalie stared at me for a solid three seconds. Then she burst out laughing.
You are serious. You actually want a disguise from a grocery store.
Okay, look, we have a leftover bin from Halloween next to the candy. Bottom shelf. Knock yourself out, Tpielberg.
I dug around the bin. It was mostly junk, but I found a pair of thick black plastic glasses with a fuzzy mustache and a massive fake nose attached.
(It's ridiculous. But it's the only thing that actually hides my features.)
I put them on and turned to Natalie.
She bit her lip, trying to hold back a laugh, looking me up and down.
Wow. Just... wow.
You look like a walking mid-life crisis. It's... certainly a look.
Does it make me unrecognizable?
It makes you look like [MC]Peter[-MC] making a very bold fashion statement. But yeah, nobody will take you seriously enough to identify you.
Good enough. I'll take them.
She walked back to the register, her hips swaying mesmerically. I followed, taking the glasses off to pay.
So, who's the lucky co-star? Or are you just stalking an ex?
I told you, it's for a film. It's very... avant-garde.
Right. Avant-garde. Well, try not to get a restraining order.
You know, if you wanted to roleplay, you could have just asked. I have much more interesting outfits in the back room than a raincoat.
(She is definitely flirting. Ask her about the outfits!)
(Shut up. Focus on the mission.)
Well, bring them here. Don't get arrested, detective.
(Time to pay up. We look like an idiot, but at least we're an incognito idiot.)

s2_gerda_route_066_gerda_visit.text: I walked across the university campus, clutching my bag strap tight. The morning air was crisp, but my palms were sweating.
My mind wasn't on lectures or grades. It was stuck on replay: Gerda in the garden, the bottle sliding down her throat, her eyes filled with that terrifying, cold determination.
"The final exam is coming soon," she had said.
Then my phone vibrated. It was a number I didn't recognize.
The message was short, blunt, and dripping with an arrogance I knew all too well.
The calibration is complete. My reflexes are under control.
I require a field test. A hostile environment. I will be at your hovel this evening. Do not be late.
(My blood ran cold. It had to be her. Gerda. How did she even get my number?)
(Heh. The queen is coming to visit the peasant's hut. She wants to see if she can handle you in the wild. This is going to be fucking legendary.)
(What do I do?! I can't just have her show up! What will [M]Mary[-M] think?)
(You're going to do exactly what she says. You're going to open the door and let the hungry wolf in. She wants the risk. Don't worry, I'll handle the rest.)
I stared at the message, standing in the middle of the busy courtyard. The rest of the day suddenly felt like a very long countdown to disaster.
(This was insane. She wasn't just toying with me anymore. She was testing herself.)
(Let her. A predator is never more vulnerable than when it thinks it's proving a point.)

s2_ntr_route_041.text: I was walking past the nurse's office when I heard a sharp voice. I stopped and peeked through the open doorway. Inside, near the open supply cabinet, a very one-sided conversation was taking place.
...That is completely unacceptable, Jessica. I told you to organize the supply cabinet, not just shove everything onto the shelves.
I know, Mrs. Sharma. I'm sorry. I just got confused with the new sorting system—
Confused? It is basic alphabetical order.
I... I know. I'll fix it.
Jessica swallowed hard. With nowhere to hide in the brightly lit room, she just clasped her hands tightly together, shrinking under Brinda's gaze.
(Pinching the bridge of her nose) भगवान की कृपा हो तुम पर...
Health and wellness are not games. If you are going to assist in my office, leave your carelessness at the door.
You will get back to that cabinet and sort it correctly. Right now. Do we understand each other?
Yes, Mrs. Sharma. Right now.
Good. See that you do.
Brinda gave a crisp nod and turned back to her desk, her posture radiating absolute authority.
(God, she's intense. She just destroyed Jessica without even raising her voice.)
(Untouchable, strict, and tightly wound. Look at how easily she made her shrink down.)
(She hides behind that conservative uniform, but we both know what kind of curves are under there. Now that is a high-stakes game.)
Watching from the doorway as Brinda stood by her desk, asserting that kind of absolute, uncompromising control... I couldn't help but think of [M]Mary[-M].
(Whenever [M]Mary[-M] gets overwhelmed, she just wraps her arms around herself, trying to make herself invisible...)
(Exactly. The complete opposite of Brinda. Terrified of her own shadow. Soft, yielding... and already broken-in.)
(It's a beautiful contrast, isn't it? The proud, iron-willed conservative who rules her domain, and the nervous wreck just waiting for her next order.)
(Makes you wonder... how would Brinda look if someone broke her down to look exactly like *that*?)

s2_ntr_route_040.text: YO! [MC]Peter[-MC]!
(Ignore him. Just get the coffee and get to the lecture.)
(Louder) Don't walk away when I'm talkin' to you, bro!
...What do you want, Darnell? I'm busy.
There you are. Almost forgot.
Forgot what?
To pass on the message. From [M]Mary[-M].
...From [M]Mary[-M]? Why would she—
She called me this morning. Early. REAL early. You were definitely still asleep.
That's... bullshit. Why would she call you?
She was... let's say, a little "preoccupied" at the time. Barely catching her breath. But she still paused to ask about you.
...What are you talking about?
She's just worried, man. She said you've been looking stressed. Even while she was... busy... she was thinking about [MC]Peter[-MC].
Stop it. I don't want to hear this.
(Loudly) Isn't that sweet, though? She barely had the energy to speak, but she made me promise to check on you.
You gotta take better care of yourself. Don't wanna make [M]Mary[-M] stress out, right? Especially when she's already so... worked up.
Back off.
Just doing a favor, man! She asked me to keep an eye on you. Since you clearly can't handle it yourself.
(To the students nearby) [MC]Peter[-MC] gets cranky without [M]Mary[-M], huh?
Later. Try not to worry her tonight, yeah? She needs her rest after this morning.
(He... he just made it sound so...)
(Oh, stop playing dumb. "Breathless." "Busy." "Early morning.")
(We both know *exactly* why she couldn't catch her breath. Don't we?)

s2_harry_office_keyhole_dark.text: (I press my eye against the keyhole again, but it's completely pitch black inside.)
(The lights must be off, or he blocked the view somehow. I can't see a single thing in there anymore.)
(Well, the show's over for now. The old man probably retreated or finally passed out from all that "stress".)
(No point lingering in the hallway staring at the dark like a creep with nothing to show for it. Let's move.)
(Yeah, good idea. There is nothing left to see here anyway. I should get going before someone catches me loitering.)

s2_ntr_route_069.text: ([M]Mary[-M]... she's actually doing it. She's going back to Walter.)
(Oh, this is gonna be rich. The little lamb running to the lead wolf for help.)
I quickly ducked into a janitor's alcove as [M]Mary[-M] walked past. She looked pale, her hands trembling, but there was a desperate resolve in her eyes.
She knocked on the heavy oak door.
(From inside, muffled) Come in.
[M]Mary[-M] entered. The door clicked shut, but the latch didn't catch completely. It stayed open just a crack. I inched closer, holding my breath, pressing my ear to the gap.
Mary. An unexpected visit. To what do I owe the pleasure?
Dean Walter... I didn't want to come back here. I really didn't.
And yet, here you are.
I tried to handle it myself. I tried to follow advice... to be firm, to set boundaries. I tried to show authority. But it was useless. He just... he doesn't care.
You are my last resort, Walter. I have nowhere else to turn.
That sounds melodramatic, Mary. What is this about?
I need to report a student. For harassment. It's... it's gotten out of control.
Harassment? That's a very serious accusation. Who are we talking about?
Darnell.
A long, cold silence filled the office. I could almost hear the temperature drop.
I see. And what, exactly, has he done?
He's been threatening me. And [MC]Peter[-MC]. He is inappropriate. He corners me... he makes vulgar comments about my body. I'm afraid of what he'll do next.
I waited for Walter to be shocked. To offer help. To call security. Instead, I heard a heavy sigh. The sound of weary disappointment.
Mary, Mary, Mary. You must understand... young athletes have excess energy. Darnell is our star player. He is full of drive, full of... testosterone.
This isn't just "energy," Walter! He's a menace! He's a bully!
He is a champion. Do you have any idea how much alumni funding depends on our basketball team making the finals this year?
Darnell isn't just a student, Mary. He is an investment. He carries the reputation of this entire university on his shoulders.
So... because he can throw a ball, he's allowed to torment people? To threaten [MC]Peter[-MC]?
He maintains order. Darnell, for all his rough edges, keeps the other athletes in line. Think of him as a necessary evil. A chaotic force, yes, but one that brings us victories.
Victories? At what cost? The humiliation... the things he says to me... It's wrong! You have to stop him!
What I *have* to do is ensure the success of this institution. And right now, that success requires Darnell to remain focused and... happy.
Causing a scandal over a few "misplaced compliments" or a young man's spirited nature would be... counterproductive. For everyone.
Are you telling me to just ignore it? To let him do whatever he wants?
I am advising you to be the mature adult in the situation. A woman of your grace can surely handle an arrogant student without escalating it to a formal incident.
Besides... if Darnell were to face disciplinary action, the athletic board would look for someone to blame. They might start reviewing all discretionary grants. Including [MC]Peter[-MC]'s.
(My blood ran cold. He's threatening me directly. He's holding my future hostage to keep her quiet.)
(Whispering) You... you wouldn't.
It would be a shame if your household's position here became... untenable. Do I make myself clear?
[M]Mary[-M] didn't answer immediately. I could hear a small, choked sound. The sound of a world collapsing.
Yes... perfectly clear.
Good. I knew you'd be reasonable. Consider his... attention... a small price to pay for [MC]Peter[-MC]'s continued stability. Now, you may go.
The door opened abruptly. I pressed myself back into the shadows.
[M]Mary[-M] stumbled out, her face completely blank, devoid of hope. She didn't even look around. She walked past me like a ghost.
(She went in there looking for a shield. And Walter just took it away.)
(She's trapped. Completely and utterly trapped. And it's all my fault.)

s2_priscilla_route_021.text: I stood by the edge of the pool, trying not to stare too obviously.
Gerda wandered the patio with her wine glass, while Priscilla lay sprawled on a sun lounger. Large headphones covered her ears, her eyes closed.
You know, [MC]Peter[-MC], it's funny—watching her lie there, tuned out to the world... when I was Priscilla’s age, everyone said we were practically identical.
Same tastes, same desires… the same weaknesses.
I can still hear you, Mother. And I’m *nothing* like you.
Of course, darling. Keep telling yourself that. But you can't deny that most people still think we're essentially copies of each other.
Gerda turned to me, gesturing with her glass.
Even [MC]Peter[-MC] here probably sees it—don’t you?
Actually, Mrs. Gerda... I’d have to disagree.
Oh?
Priscilla’s different from you. She’s got something… unique.
She’s more… intense. I don’t think anyone could confuse her with anyone else. Especially you.
You… really think that?
Definitely. No offense, Mrs. Gerda, but Priscilla is her own woman.
Gerda took a slow sip of wine, feigning surprise.
Well, isn’t that charming? Perhaps I underestimated how perceptive you are, [MC]Peter[-MC].
See? I told you. I’m nothing like you. I don’t need to be a flirtatious alcoholic to get attention.
Gerda laughed softly, completely unbothered.
Careful, darling. [MC]Peter[-MC] might end up preferring exactly *that* about you.
Or maybe he already does?
Priscilla flushed, grabbing her headphones.
Whatever. Unlike you, I don’t care who he prefers.
Gerda walked past me toward the house, her hand brushing my arm. Her voice dropped to a whisper.
Nice performance, [MC]Peter[-MC]. Meet me later. We'll discuss how you can further "appreciate" our differences.
My heart raced as she disappeared through the patio doors.
(Performance? I mean... I know she told me to say it.)
(But looking at Priscilla now... I think I actually meant it.)
What are you standing there for? She's gone. You can stop sucking up now.
I wasn't sucking up, Priscilla. I meant what I said.
She blinked, caught off guard again, then looked away.
...Whatever. Just get back to work.
(Nicely played, [MC]Peter[-MC]. Nothing hooks her like being told she's better than Mommy. This is gonna be fun.)

s2_opening_tiffany_stub.text: I tried to look away, to focus on something else-anything else-to break the tension.
She snaps her fingers sharply. The sound cracks through the room like a whip.
Eyes on me. I'm not done with you yet.
(Don't look away. That's a sign of weakness.)
(She is testing you. If you flinch, she wins. Stare her down.)
(Easier said than done. Her eyes are like lasers.)

s2_gerda_route_042_priscilla_reaction.text: I was trying to find a book on horticulture for some other bullshit task when she found me. Priscilla, looking bored and beautiful, was leaning against a bookshelf, spinning an apple on her palm.
Finally decided to learn how to read, gutter guy? Or are you just hiding from actual work?
(A day ago, her words would have stung. Now, they felt… childish. Tame. After what I’d experienced with her mother in the cellar, Priscilla’s insults were like kitten scratches.)
Just trying to better myself, princess. Something you might want to consider.
She raised a perfectly sculpted eyebrow, a flicker of surprise in her eyes. She wasn't used to me talking back.
Careful. That almost sounded like confidence. It doesn't suit you. You look constipated.
(She has no idea what real confidence is. But she'll learn. We'll show her the same training session we taught her mother.)
Just trying to keep up in this house. It's a demanding environment.
She pushed off the bookshelf and walked towards me, her eyes narrowed, searching my face.
You’re different. Ever since you went to the stables with me. And today… you smell like my mother’s perfume and old metal. What the fuck have you been up to?
I just gave her a small, enigmatic smile. The same kind of smile her mother had given me in the foyer.
Just taking care of the family… assets.
She stared at me for a long moment, the apple forgotten in her hand. She was confused, irritated, and undeniably intrigued. I had just become a puzzle she didn't know how to solve.
You're a fucking weirdo. Stop smiling like that and go trim a hedge or something. You're creeping me out.
She turned and walked away, but I could feel her gaze on my back.
(The game was expanding. More players, more secrets. And I was starting to enjoy it.)

s2_gerda_dungeon_device_repeat.text: (The tapestry-covered frame. I don't want to know what kind of "correction" happened on that wood.)

s2_mary_keyhole_day_stub.text: I crouched down slightly, aligning my eye with the keyhole of [M]Mary[-M]'s bedroom door.
(Just a quick peek. Nothing wrong with making sure she's okay...)
(Yeah, 'checking if she's okay'. That's exactly why we're hunched over like a gargoyle in the hallway. We're looking for that fat ass.)
I could only see a narrow slice of the bedroom. A piece of the wall, part of the floor. Empty.
(She's not in the frame. Probably downstairs or doing chores somewhere else.)
(Shame. I was hoping to catch her bending over to make the bed. Imagine that view locked perfectly in this tiny circle.)
(I need to get up before I cramp my neck. Or worse, before she opens the door and hits me in the face.)
I stood up, brushing off my knees, and stepped away from the door.

s2_gerda_route_083_.text: What the hell’s up with [M]Mary[-M]? Why’s she red as a fucking tomato and damn near knocking over the flower vase?
No clue. Maybe she overheated or something?
Overheated? That girl never breaks a sweat over anything. Always so calm and proper.
Now she looks like she got caught with her hand in the cookie jar.
I’m sure it’s just… a random heatwave. Happens to the best of us.
Listen, [MC]Peter[-MC], if you’ve fucked up again and landed in some dumbass mess… I know how clumsy you are.
Did [M]Mary[-M] walk in on something… uh… nasty?
Nah, don’t think so. Maybe she heard some shocking gossip. Who knows?
You know, I thought you were incapable of anything remotely interesting. You and ‘scandal’ go together like a cat and a cucumber-fucking ridiculous.
Guess you’re underestimating me, [T]Tiffany[-T]. Maybe one day you’ll be surprised.
Oh, please, surprise me. I doubt you’ve got the balls for it.
[M]Mary[-M]’s more likely to fall for a rabid armadillo than you are to impress me.
Anything’s possible. Maybe one day you’ll see I can be… pretty damn interesting.
Can’t wait. Right, I’m off to find [M]Mary[-M]-maybe she’ll spill what really happened here.
Good luck digging for the truth, [T]Tiffany[-T]. Doubt you’re getting the full story.

s2_gerda_route_078_priscilla_after_bedro.text: Hey! Have you seen my goddamn parents lately?
No, everything is not fucking alright. They're both acting weird-Dad’s sulking around like a kicked dog, and Mom…
...well, Mom’s been walking around the house like she spent the weekend horseback riding without a saddle. It’s creepy as fuck.
(Horseback riding, huh? More like a rodeo on our fucking stallion cock.)
Priscilla narrows her eyes, suddenly suspicious, leaning in slightly.
You were at our place recently… did you notice anything strange? They were making the weirdest noises-like they were torturing each other or something.
Uh, nope. Didn’t see anything unusual… just gardening.
God, you’re useless. Whatever, it's probably their twisted idea of marital therapy. If they keep it up, the neighbors are going to call the fucking cops.
(If the cops saw what we've done in that bedroom, they'd call the goddamn army.)
Sorry I couldn't be more helpful…

Behind me, the clicking of Jennifer's stilettos sounded like the ticking of a bomb. She was fast. Too fast.
(She’s gaining on us! She has the reach advantage! Go!)
I sprinted through the living room, sliding in my socks, knocking over a pile of magazines.
The front door loomed ahead. A rectangle of potential freedom.
I grabbed the handle. I threw the door open.
Sunlight hit my face. Fresh air. Escape.
I launched myself out onto the porch at full speed.
(I made it! Just one jump and I'm on the grass!)
(ABORT! ABORT! THE RUNWAY IS BLOCKED!)
I froze... or I tried to.
Standing on the porch, completely filling the frame, was Doya.
She wasn't just standing there. She was posed. Calm. Monumental.
She adjusted her glasses, looking at me speeding towards her like a bug hitting a windshield. She didn't flinch. She braced.
In a hurry, sugar?
BRAKES! I HAVE NO BRAKES!
(Aim for the center! Brace for softness!)
WHAM.
Physics took a day off. I didn't bounce off. I was absorbed.
My face buried itself deep into the softest, warmest, most fragrant substance in the universe.
The impact was like crashing into a cloud made of cocoa butter.
Oh my!
She laughs-a deep, chesty rumble that vibrates directly against my nose.
You certainly know how to make an entrance, [MC]Peter[-MC]!
(I can't breathe. I don't want to breathe. I want to live here.)

I hung there for a second, suspended by gravity and tits. Then, survival instinct kicked in.

Bad idea.

Taksh looked miserable. He was twisted in pain, eyes pleading with me.
So.
This is the urgent matter? Using Mrs. Doya as a landing pad?
Mom, let go! My ear is stretching!

(Right flank is closed. The Nurse is armed with disappointment. Check the right!)
I snapped my head to the left.
Worse idea.
Darnell was there.
He wasn't just angry. He was looking at the wet spot my face had left on his mother's dress.
His jaw was clenched so hard I could hear his teeth grinding from here.
You...
Dead. You are dead.
Gasps. [MC]Peter[-MC]! Did you just... motorboat my mom?
(Left flank is hostile. Extremely hostile. Darnell is charging his laser.)
I stumbled back, trying to put distance between me and Darnell’s fists.
I stepped back to get the full picture.
(Oh god. There’s so many of them.)
It was a perfect formation.
The angry son. The shocked sister. The strict nurse. The suffering friend. And in the middle, the immovable object herself-Doya, smiling like she enjoyed every second of it.
(I am trapped. Jennifer behind me. The Avengers of Pain in front of me.)
(Look at them. It’s a renaissance painting of your screwed-up life.)
(Smile, [MC]Peter[-MC]. You just motorboated the boss. Own it.)
THERE HE IS! GRAB HIM!
GET HIM OFF THE PORCH!
(This is it. This is how I die.)
HE'S A MENACE! LOOK AT WHAT HE JUST DID!
I'm gonna break his fucking jaw! Come here, you little shit!
Before Darnell could grab me, the front door flew wide open.
[MC]Peter[-MC]! What on earth is going on out here?!
[M]Mary[-M] stumbled out onto the porch. Her face was already flushed a deep, feverish red from what had just happened between us in the kitchen.
She was breathing heavily, clutching her apron, her eyes wide as she took in the chaotic scene: Doya's wet dress, Darnell's clenched fists, and Jennifer's screaming.
Your guy just dove face-first into my mom's chest, Mary! I'm gonna kill him!
He tripped! He has a terrible fever today! He's completely disoriented!
She didn't hesitate. She practically threw herself between me and Darnell, grabbing my arm with trembling, sweaty hands.

You better leash your fucking dog, Mary, or I'll put him down myself!
Darnell took a threatening step forward, chest puffed out, pure adrenaline and rage in his eyes.
(I should fight back, but my legs feel like lead. And [M]Mary[-M]'s grip on my arm is bruising.)
[MC]Peter[-MC], GO! Go to your lectures right now! Get off this porch!
She shoved me hard down the steps.

As she pushed me, her heavy chest brushed against my back. I could feel her heart hammering. She was terrified of the situation, but she was still radiating that raw, nervous heat from our moment at the stove.
(She’s using the chaos to save your ass. Run, idiot, before he actually swings.)
(I didn't need to be told twice.)
I stumbled down the driveway, ignoring Jennifer's shrieks and Darnell's furious swearing behind me.
I broke into a dead sprint toward the university campus, my heart pounding against my ribs and my jeans still painfully tight.

s2_gerda_route_003_.text: A few moments later, while I was trimming the hedges near the terrace, the heavy glass doors slid open.

He gave me a final, firm pat on the shoulder that felt more like a shove, and then continued down the hall, leaving me standing frozen.
I stood there alone in the busy hallway, the weight of the entire corrupt system settling on my shoulders.

s2_gerda_route_085_.text: (The air in this house is thick with money, perfume, and something else… something rotten. I just need to find the front door without running into anyone else.)
As I rounded a corner, I heard muffled voices coming from a study. The door was closed, but the sliver of light underneath indicated someone was inside.
(Okay, not my business. Just keep walking. The last thing I need is to get caught eavesdropping in this fucking house.)
(Whoa, hold on there, champ. Where's your sense of adventure? Don't you hear that? Quiet, intense voices. That’s the sound of the King trying to hold his crown.)
(Or it's just Harry talking to his stockbroker. I don't care. I want to leave.)
(Boring. What if it's about us? What if it's about Gerda? Don't you want to know what they say? Come on, take a peek through the keyhole. What's the harm?)
(Damn it... you're right. Just a quick peek.)
I knelt down, pressing my eye to the old-fashioned, ornate keyhole. The opening was small, my view restricted.
I couldn't see much... just a sliver of Harry's massive desk, and occasionally a figure moving past. But I could hear them perfectly. It was Harry… and Maria, the housekeeper.
She hasn't left her room, sir. But she asked me to wash... the sheets again. The silk ones.
There’s a long beat. When Harry finally speaks, his voice is tight, slightly higher than usual, as if he’s forgetting to breathe properly.
That’s fine, Maria. It's... it's just another phase. She gets restless. You know how she is.
It feels different this time. The way she looks at him... The way she looks at you when he's around.
(Him? Me? A cold knot forms in my stomach.)
He is... he's just a distraction. A temporary amusement she found to alleviate her boredom. He means nothing.
(A distraction? Is that what he tells himself to sleep at night? Pathetic.)
Distractions don't usually leave marks, sir. And they don't usually look at the master of the house the way he does.
I hear the clink of glass against crystal. Harry is drinking. The sound of pouring is slightly unsteady.
It’s a game, Maria. An arrangement. I... I allow it. It keeps her occupied.
If you say so, sir. But games have rules. And I think she enjoys breaking yours.
Enough. Just... prepare the guest room for me tonight. I need quiet to think.
We will... discuss this matter further later.
Her voice drops, lacking its usual crisp professionalism. There's almost pity in it now.
Yes, Mr. Sterling. I will make sure the door is secured.
I heard a heavy sigh, followed by footsteps, so I quickly stood up and backed away into the shadows.
(An arrangement... He's terrified of his own wife. And I'm the monster she's using to break him.)

s2_opening_033.text: She flew off the last step, storming into the living room like a hurricane.
She was wearing jeans and a tight t-shirt now, but her wet hair was whipping around her face. She looked ready to commit murder.
You sick freak! Do you think I didn't see you upstairs? Do you think-
She marched toward me, raising a finger to poke my chest... and then she stopped.
She had stepped past me to get in my face. Which meant she was now facing the large front window.
Her mouth opened to scream, but no sound came out. Her fury evaporated, replaced by pure, unadulterated confusion.
Her eyes went wide. I thought they might actually pop out of her skull.
She squinted, leaning forward slightly, as if trying to resolve a optical illusion.
Is that... a person? Or did a giant, hairy peach just fly into the glass?
(She’s confused. She thinks someone taped a shag carpet to the window.)

s2_gerda_route_028_.text: I had just sat down on the edge of my bed, intending to watch a bit of TV before finally turning in for the night. The quiet drone from the screen began calming my nerves after today’s stressful encounter with Harry.
Suddenly, my phone rang sharply, jolting me back into tension. My heart jumped when I saw Gerda’s name appear on the screen, immediately pulling me back to this morning’s humiliating memory.
[MC]Peter[-MC], darling, I hope you’ve recovered from our little incident this morning.
Tomorrow I’d like you to meet me at the shopping center. As for why, well, you’ll find out when you get there.
You won’t disappoint me, will you?
Her voice was calm, confident, effortlessly commanding. Anxiety surged through me, mixing oddly with excitement.
Deep inside, I felt Red stir again, whispering his dark encouragement.
(Oh, [MC]Peter[-MC]… Seems your little friend really made quite the impression on her.)
(Looks like she finally recognized what you’re truly packing. Don’t disappoint her now.)
Of course, Gerda. I’ll be there.
She hung up immediately, leaving me staring anxiously at the phone screen, unsettled yet strangely eager for whatever tomorrow might bring.

s2_ntr_route_013.text: I stood outside the bathroom door, leaning against the wall. Waiting.
I heard the lock click shut. Then the sound of the shower curtain being pulled back.
Silence for two seconds. And then...
(Muffled, from inside) ...What?!
A pause.
(Muffled, panicked whisper) Oh my god... No. No, no, no! How did this...?
Then came the frantic sounds of plastic hooks rattling violently. She must have snatched it off the door so fast she nearly ripped the hanger down.
(Gotcha. She found the surprise.)
I stepped up to the door and knocked. Two sharp raps.
[M]Mary[-M]? Everything okay in there?
The rustling stopped instantly. Dead silence.
(Voice high, breathless) Yes! Yes! I'm fine! Just... just a minute!
I could hear her frantic movements. The sound of a cabinet opening, then closing. Then the rustle of terry cloth.
You sounded... upset. Did you slip?
No! I mean... yes! I slipped! On the rug! Just give me a second!
After a long, agonizing ten seconds, the lock clicked.
The door opened a crack. Then a bit wider.
[M]Mary[-M] stood there, wrapped tightly in a large white bath towel. A second, smaller towel was twisted around her wet hair like a turban.
Her face was pale, devoid of makeup, but her chest and shoulders were flushed a deep, blotchy red.
She was clutching the body towel against her chest with a desperate, white-knuckled grip.
Sorry, sweetie. I just... I got startled. I'm clumsy today.
(She's trembling. She's holding that towel like it's a shield. She definitely hid it in there.)
You sure? I heard you say "Oh my god."
Did I? I... I saw a spider! A huge one. Right on the door. It scared me to death.
(A spider. Cute. A hot pink, stringy spider.)
Do you want me to come in and kill it?
No! I... I already flushed it. It's gone.
She shifted her weight nervously, trying to close the door.
Anyway, I really need to shower now. So if you don't mind—
As she moved to shut the door, her grip on the towel shifted slightly.
She had wrapped herself in such a panic that she hadn't secured the bundle against her chest properly.
*Plap.*
Something small and hot pink slipped out from the bottom folds of the white towel and landed softly on the tiled floor between us.
We both looked down.
There, lying on the pristine white threshold like a dead, exotic insect, was the micro-bikini. A tangle of hot pink strings and a tiny triangle of shiny fabric.
Silence. Absolute, suffocating silence.
[M]Mary[-M] stared at it. Her mouth opened, but no sound came out. She looked from the floor to me, and then back to the floor, her eyes wide with horror.
(Gravity is a bitch, isn't it?)
You dropped your... spider.
(Stammering, frantically pulling the towel tighter) [MC]Peter[-MC]... I... I can explain! It's just a joke gift from a friend! I was taking it to the trash, I swear!
You're sweating, [M]Mary[-M]. And it's still damp. You were wearing it just now, weren't you?
The lie caught in her throat. The realization that I saw right through her pristine, saintly facade hit her like a physical blow.
The shame was suffocating, but beneath it... a twisted, heavy relief washed over her that her dirty secret was finally out in the open. She didn't have to pretend anymore.
(Dropping her gaze, her voice breaking into a defeated whisper) Please... don't tell anyone.
It wasn't a request. It was a plea. A surrender.
In that moment, the power dynamic shifted forever. She wasn't just [M]Mary[-M] anymore. She was a woman with a dirty secret, and she had just handed me all the power.
(Welcome to the big leagues, pal. She's all yours now.)

FoxClubFrontView_01.text: Don’t you know who I am?! Check the VIP list again, man! I’m Darnell! The Darnell!
I don’t care if you’re the Pope, man. You’re not on the list, and you’re wearing bright red sneakers to a high-class club.
Sneakers?! These are limited edition Tordans! I had to fight a guy in an alley just to get this colorway! They cost more than your car!
They’re still sneakers. And you're scuffing up my pavement. Step aside before I pick you up and move you myself. You’re blocking the actual paying customers.
Don't you dare touch me! You’re making a huge mistake, man. Huge! When I buy this entire block, you’re the first one fired!
Yeah, yeah. Keep walking, future billionaire. Next!
(I should probably pretend I don't know him right now.)
(Or we could just wait for the bouncer to actually throw him into the dumpster. That sounds like prime entertainment.)

s2_mc_room_locked_chest.text: (My old storage chest. I keep my old comics, video games, and private stuff locked in there so nobody snoops.)
(Oh yeah, the 'stash'. Handcuffs, ropes, a couple of blindfolds... wait, we don't actually have those yet. We definitely need to upgrade our inventory if we're gonna do this right!)
(Like I said, it's just comics and games! Keep your creepy BDSM fantasies out of my stuff.)

s2_foxclub_exit_placeholder.text: (The main exit. The cool night air and the quiet streets are just on the other side of those glass doors.)
(A part of me wants to just turn around, walk out, and go back to my normal, boring life.)
(Running away? We just got invited to the big leagues, [MC]Peter[-MC]. You are not walking out that door until we've completely ruined the Sterling family.)
(He's right. I can't leave yet. I have unfinished business here tonight.)

s2_ntr_route_048.text: Oh! Good morning, [MC]Peter[-MC]. Did you sleep well?
Morning. You're up early.
I just wanted to make sure you had a good breakfast before you left. It's important to have energy for the day!
She slid a massive plate of pancakes in front of me, stacked almost impossibly high and dripping with syrup.
Whoa, [M]Mary[-M], this is... a lot of pancakes. Are we expecting company?
No! I just... I think you need to keep your strength up. You're looking a little thin.
(Thin? I've been the same weight for three years.)
(She's overcompensating. Trying to smother me with attention because she's absolutely terrified of what Darnell is going to do to me today.)
And... listen, [MC]Peter[-MC]. At the university today... you'll be careful, won't you?
Careful? Of what? Pop quizzes?
No, just... people. Try not to get into any... disagreements. Just keep your head down. For me?
(She's terrified. And she can't even say his name.)
[M]Mary[-M], I'll be fine. Don't worry so much. What are you doing today, anyway?
I... I think I'm going to start going to the gym regularly again. Starting today.
The gym? You haven't been there in a while. What's the sudden rush?
Well, I've just been thinking. I need to set a goal for myself. I've let myself go a bit lately, and... I really need to lose some weight. Get in better shape.
(Lose weight? She's always been completely fine with her body.)
(Until last night. One phone call, a few degrading words, and suddenly she can't stand looking in the mirror.)
So, I'll probably be out for a while this afternoon.
Good luck with that, [M]Mary[-M]. Don't push yourself too hard on your first day back.
I won't. Have a good day at the university, [MC]Peter[-MC].
She grabbed her purse and hurried out the front door. I stood alone in the kitchen, staring at the empty doorway.
(Less than twelve hours later, and she's already twisting herself into knots for him.)
(The university can wait. I have to see this with my own eyes. I need to see exactly what happens when Darnell "coincidentally" bumps into her there.)

s2_priscilla_route_009.text: As I rounded a corner, I stopped dead in my tracks. Maria was there on the floor.
She was on her hands and knees on the thick carpet, focused on scrubbing a small, dark stain near the base of a large vase.
Her short maid's uniform was stretched tight across her wide hips. As she worked on the stain, her hips swayed in a slow, hypnotic rhythm.
Her skirt had ridden up high, revealing a pair of simple black panties that were stretched taut over the perfect, round curve of her ass.
(Holy shit... Now that's a five-star view. Black panties and everything.)
I just stood there, my throat suddenly dry, watching the rhythmic movement of her hips. I couldn't move.
Without stopping her work, without even looking up, her voice was calm and steady.
Señor Peter. You look like you have seen a ghost.
(My breath hitched. How did she know I was here? She hadn't even turned around. She was still focused on that damn stain.)
Uh, no, Maria. Just… tired. Long day.
She continued scrubbing the stain, her movements efficient and deliberate. She spoke to the carpet as much as to me.
This house has many ghosts. And many cages. Some are made of gold, but they are cages all the same.
(What the hell was she talking about? And why was she telling me this now, like this, without even looking at me?)
I… I don’t understand.
She didn't stop scrubbing, her focus still entirely on the small, dark stain on the carpet. Her hips continued their slow, rhythmic sway.
The master of the house is not always the one with the most freedom. Sometimes, the one who wears the crown also wears the heaviest chains. Remember that, young man.
The words hung in the air, heavy and strange. She didn't look up. She didn't pause again. The conversation was over. She had dismissed me without even looking at me.
(There was nothing left to say. I just stood there for another moment, watching the hypnotic movement of her ass, her cryptic words echoing in my mind.)
(This bitch is playing a whole different game... I fucking love it.)

(But more importantly, the coast is totally clear, pal. The King and Queen are busy. This is the perfect opportunity to snoop around the master bedroom AND the Princess's room. Don't chicken out until we've seen what secrets both rooms hold.)

s2_ntr_route_063.text: (Just gotta get through today. Maybe Darnell will just… not exist for a few hours. A guy can dream, right?)
(Yeah, and maybe [T]Tiffany[-T] will beg you to eat her ass for breakfast. Keep dreaming, loser.)
Suddenly, Roger appeared, walking past me and intentionally bumping my shoulder hard.
Watch where you’re going, fuckface.
(Here we go again…)
It’s a wide hallway, Roger.
Got a problem? You know, Darnell ain’t here to hold your hand. Maybe I should show you some respect myself.
Before Roger could do anything else, Darnell’s voice cut through the air. He appeared at the end of the hall, leaning casually against a concrete pillar. He isn’t angry; he’s calm, which is worse.
Yo, Roger. What do you think you’re doin’?
D-Darnell! Bro, I was just… messin' with this pussy.
Darnell pushed off the pillar and stopped in front of Roger, ignoring me completely. He looked Roger up and down with cold amusement.
Nah. See, that’s where you’re wrong. You don’t get to mess with him.
Wait... really? I thought you hated this loser. Since when do you have his back?
I ain't "having his back."
He’s my bitch to fuck with. Nobody else’s. You got that?
Oh. Shit. My bad, bro. I didn't know he was... yours.
Now get the fuck outta my sight.
See? I take care of my property.
(I felt my stomach turn. I wanted to wipe the feeling of his hand off my face. I wanted to scream at him.)
(But I didn't. I just stood there while he called me his "bitch" in front of everyone.)
(Because you know he's right. Roger would have just beaten you up. But Darnell... Darnell owns you. And that is so much worse.)

ParkFrontView_05.text: (Janice was standing at the very edge of the park, keeping a wide distance from the wrought-iron gates of Sterling Manor.)
(She was staring at the building like it might lunge at her.)
Afraid the house is going to bite?
I wouldn't put it past that place. I don't go any closer than this path right here.
The shadows make it easier to see what that place really is. Sterling Manor... It looks like a mausoleum.
It’s a cage, Peter. A big, expensive cage. I bet the people inside are screaming, but the walls are too thick.
You work there, right? The gardener?
Be careful. I refuse to step foot near that property. That place has bad juju.
I can feel it in my bones. Don’t let them turn you beige.

s2_harry_route_001.text: We were right there. Seconds away. And that sweating, pathetic buzzkill ruined it.
He’s her husband, Red. It’s his gym. He had a right to be there.
He didn’t come in to help her. He came in because he was terrified. He smelled it in the air.
So what? He still kicked us out.
Exactly. He is the lock on the door. And as long as he’s standing there wringing his hands, we aren’t getting back in.
I’m saying we need to remove him from the equation.
Remove him? You mean... hurt him?
Don’t be crude. I’m talking about breaking his will. We need to twist him until he snaps open.
Then you go back to being the invisible gardener who just *watches*. Is that what you want?
Then we deal with Harry. Soon.

s2_priscilla_route_003.text: I step into the library, immediately hit by the stale smell of old paper and dust.
The sheer number of books stacked on endless shelves makes me instantly regret agreeing to handle this shit alone.
It’s painfully clear: finding materials for this damn project without Priscilla is gonna suck badly.
(Alright, [MC]Peter[-MC], let’s just get this over with.)
Several hours later…
I’m slumped at a table in the library, buried beneath a pile of old textbooks and loose notes.
My eyes feel like they’re burning, and hours of fruitless searching have left me completely exhausted.
(Why the fuck am I doing this solo?)
(Because Priscilla’s a lazy-ass bitch. You’re busting your ass here while she’s probably sipping lattes with her shitty friends.)
(She said she’d help. This is fucking bullshit.)
Frustrated, I push away from the table and head to one of the library’s ancient computers in the corner, desperately hoping to find at least something useful there.
The machine hums painfully slow, its screen flickering as if it’s to die any second.
(Come on, you worthless piece of junk…)
While clicking through endless menus, something catches my eye: a long list of overdue books.
Weirdly, one name stands out, Jessica, that new student.
She’s got a ridiculous number of books checked out, some overdue by months. What the hell?
(Jesus, is Jessica stealing all these books or something?)
(Probably building her own personal library. Pretty fucking bold for a new girl.)
(Not my problem. I’ve got enough shit to deal with already.)
Dragging myself back to my seat, I open yet another dusty old textbook, determined to find something useful before they kick me out.
Red’s mocking whispers keep creeping into my thoughts, but I push his bullshit away and force myself to concentrate, ignoring the creeping suspicion about Jessica.
Hours pass, and it’s dark outside by the time I finally decide to leave.
I step out of the university building into the chilly evening air, exhausted and mentally drained.
Just as I’m adjusting my worn jacket, I nearly collide head-on with someone standing right outside.
It’s Jessica.
She’s clutching an armful of books tightly against her chest, her eyes widening in panic as she sees me.
Clearly startled, she seems to momentarily freeze.
Oh, uh-hey, [MC]Peter[-MC]. I… just stayed late after my lecture today.
Without waiting for my reply, Jessica hurries past me, disappearing quickly down the dimly lit street, books still pressed protectively against her chest.
(What the hell was that all about? Why was she so freaked out and what’s with all those books?)
(Well, that wasn’t suspicious at all. Pretty sure you just interrupted a crime spree.)
(Not my business. I’m too damn tired to deal with any more weirdness tonight.)
Pulling my jacket tighter, I finally head home, deciding to leave whatever Jessica’s hiding firmly behind me.

UniversityHallway_04.text: Taksh! Stop right there! Your collar is twisted! You look like a homeless person!
Mom, I can fix my own collar. I'm late for a lecture. Please stop touching me.
And you are too thin! Are you eating the lentils I packed? You look grey.
I will bring you vitamins tomorrow. Strong ones.
Mom, I'm twenty years old! I eat fine! Can we not do this in the middle of the hallway?
Let them look! Let them see a mother who cares! Unlike that woman, Sara... letting her daughter run wild...
Please don't bring Professor Arnette into this. Just... go back to the clinic, mom. I'll call you later.
Respect your mother! And pull up your pants!

s2_mc_bathroom_shower_cabin.text: (The shower. I should probably take one, I feel a bit sweaty after being out all day.)
(Why shower alone when we live with two gorgeous women? Next time [T]Tiffany[-T] steps in there, we should just strip down and 'accidentally' walk in. Tell her we want to save water.)
(She would absolutely murder me. Or kick me out. Probably both. If I'm taking a shower, the door stays locked.)

s2_opening_011.text: I glanced nervously at the wooden chair. The crumpled shirt, the "Cum Shirt", lay there like a smoking gun.
It looked innocent enough, but I knew better. It was stiff with evidence.
Sniff. Sniff.
[T]Tiffany[-T] wrinkled her nose. She took a step closer to the chair, then a step back, looking confused.
Okay, seriously. What died in here?
It smells like... a public pool. Sharp. Chemical.
But mixed with... is that [M]Mary[-M]'s lavender water?
You know, that cheap stuff she buys at the discount store? It's choking me.
(It's a custom blend. 'Eau de [M]Mary[-M]'. Hints of poverty and lust.)
What were you two doing? Bonding over bleach? Or was she... helping you with a science project?
(She’s staring at me. Her eyes are drilling holes in my skull. She knows something is wrong.)
[CHOICE FRAME]
She was just cleaning! You know how she gets. She saw dust and went into a frenzy.
Cleaning? [MC]Peter[-MC], she looked like she was high.
Her pupils were blown wide open. She looked like she was about to eat the furniture.
That wasn't "cleaning mode." That was "I forgot my meds" mode.
I forced a smirk, trying to channel a fraction of Red’s confidence.
Why the interrogation? Jealous? Did you want to help me with my... laundry?
Scoffs.
Please. I’d rather touch a live wire.
But don't think I don't see you deflecting. You're hiding something dirty, and I'm going to find out what it is.
I said nothing. I just felt a bead of sweat roll down my temple.
The silence is deafening, [MC]Peter[-MC].
And you're sweating like a sinner in church. Gross.
(She knows. She can smell the biology in the air.)
(That mix of chlorine and cheap lavender? It’s confusing her brain. She’s disgusted, but she can’t stop sniffing. It’s primal.)
Whatever. Just... spray some Tebreze. It smells like a sweaty gym in here.
A gym where something weird happened.

s2_sara_route_039_1.text: Sunlight streamed through the half-closed blinds of my bedroom. It was barely noon.
(Skipping my lectures today was definitely the right call. I needed a break from all the university drama.)
(Telling [M]Mary[-M] I felt sick was almost too easy. She bought it immediately and told me to stay in bed.)
I finally settled into my desk chair, stretching my arms with a satisfied groan.
I flipped open my laptop, the screen flashing to life.
(Now, let's see... I can finally finish that game I started last week, or maybe just binge some shows for a few hours.)
I reached for my mouse, ready to launch the game, when I heard quick footsteps hurrying down the hall.
(Wait, isn't [M]Mary[-M] supposed to be downstairs?)
*Knock, knock.* The door clicked open before I could even answer.
[M]Mary[-M] peeked her head in, her brow furrowed in genuine concern.
She stepped into the room, holding her phone against her chest.
I quickly minimized my tabs, slumped my shoulders to look weak, and spun my chair around to face her.
(Coughing lightly) Hey, [M]Mary[-M]. Is everything okay?
Umm, [MC]Peter[-MC], sweetheart?
Your professor just called… Arnette, I think her name was?
She sounded very… anxious. Quite frantic, actually. She was really concerned about you being absent from her seminars today.
She practically begged me to make sure you get to campus as soon as possible. Is everything okay between you two?
(Perfect. Sounds like withdrawal must be hitting her pretty hard right now…)
Oh, that's totally fine, [M]Mary[-M]. Honestly, I'm feeling much better now, so I'll get dressed and head to campus soon.
Thanks for letting me know.
Honey, are you really sure you're feeling better already? You seemed so sick this morning.
I don't want you rushing back to the university and getting worse just because someone asked. You should rest until you're properly recovered.
Don't worry about me, [M]Mary[-M]—I'll survive. Promise.
Aww, sweetheart, you make me so proud, being so responsible and dedicated!
(Heh heh… proud enough to let me bend you right over that banister and fill you up, [M]Mary[-M]? One day soon, we'll see…)
Thanks, [M]Mary[-M]. I really appreciate you checking in on me.

s2_harry_transition_bathroom.text: (What is Harry doing sneaking around the bathroom?)
(Stop and watch. He thinks nobody is around.)
Harry looked nervously over his shoulder, checking the hallway behind him. Satisfied he was alone, he reached into the basket.
He delicately pulled out a piece of dark, sheer fabric. It was one of Gerda's expensive black lace panties.
(Look closer, idiot. He's not lifting it to his nose. He's lifting it to his waist.)
My jaw dropped. Harry stood facing the large vanity mirror, holding the delicate, tiny black lace down against the front of his expensive tailored trousers.
He stared at his own reflection, his face a complex battlefield of absolute horror, deep shame, and an undeniable, flushed arousal. His breathing was shallow and rapid.
(He's imagining wearing them. He's imagining being the wife.)
(The ultimate cuckold. He doesn't just want a bull to fuck his wife; he wants to be the submissive little sissy watching from the corner. Fucking brilliant.)
I shifted my weight, and my sneaker squeaked loudly against the bathroom tile.
Harry jumped as if he'd been electrocuted.
He dropped the panties back into the basket like they were on fire, his face turning a violent, sweaty shade of purple.

Before he could even turn around to see who made the noise, Maria stepped into the bathroom from the adjoining master bedroom. She glanced at the basket on the vanity, then at Harry's sweating, guilty face.
Is everything alright, Master Harry? I was just coming to put those away... unless you were thinking of trying them on? Black is a very slimming color.
I... I was just... checking to see if these were completely dry!
He practically ran out of the room, keeping his head down, desperately trying to hide the obvious bulge in his pants.
(Oh, we are going to have so much fun breaking this man. He’s a walking fetish just waiting to be cracked open.)

s2_sara_route_017_entry_table_basket.text: Further down the hall, my fingers carefully pulled a wicker basket from the side table. It was heavy with papers.
A standard credit card statement. A copy of a local newspaper.
(Credit card statement. Perfect. This isn't junk; this is intelligence. We could find spending habits, specific vendors, maybe an address... Look for vulnerabilities.)
(Just some old mail and a few bills. I slipped them back into the basket, trying to keep them exactly as they were.)

ParkFrontView_01.text: Got one! A quarter! That’s… that’s twenty-five cents closer to freedom.
Alan. Get out of the water. It’s freezing.
Peter! My pal! My favorite neighbor!
Say… you look strong. You got a dollar? Just a dollar? For a… sandwich?
I don't have any cash or food on me, Alan. If I did, I'd give it to you, I swear.
Empty pockets... yeah, I know that feeling all too well.
You’re a good pal anyway, Peter. Don’t end up like me. Don’t let the ghosts catch you.
The ones in the big house. They eat people. They ate me. And they spat out… this.

s2_gerda_route_036_harry_reaction.text: (I climbed the stone steps from the cellar, my legs still shaking. The smell of sex, raw sweat, and old iron was clinging to me.)
(I had just left his wife on the floor, wearing her ancestor's helmet, completely soaked in her own juices.)
(As I pulled the heavy wooden door shut, it clicked with a sound of finality.)
(I turned to cross the patio... and froze.)
(Harry was standing right there in the shadows of the garden. He hadn't just arrived. He had been waiting.)
Is she... is she alive?
She's... resting. Sir.
Was it... rough?
I didn't answer. I didn't have to.
The heavy silence between us in the cool night air was answer enough.
She needs... she needs that intensity. I couldn't... I could never provide that kind of... impact.
He let out a shaky breath, picked up the bucket, and stepped past me. He pulled the heavy cellar door open and began to slowly descend the stone steps.
I stood in the doorway, watching him. He didn't look at Gerda's ruined figure resting in the shadows.
He just dipped the mop into the water, wrung it out, and started pushing it across the wet, stained stone floor.
(Holy fucking shit. Look at him. He heard everything through that door. The clanking of the gauntlet. Her screaming into that helmet.)
